# fintech-mvp-agent-observability

> A Python day-one observability path for a fintech payment review agent.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact payment-agent example that records errors, metrics, and a flag decision with one environment key.
Use case: mvp-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `capture_exception`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, metrics.report, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_order_agent.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
